================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO YE-AFTER EFFECTS - OKUTSHA
Uguqulelo 9.2.9  -  ngo-Oktobha 2026
================================================================================

IITHIMA ZE-ANIME ezintsha ezingama-33 zijoyina ezo ze-Demon Slayer, iziphumo zemawusi
zeethima ngoku ziyabonakala ngokwenene ngaphakathi kwi-After Effects, kwaye uMkhethi
weThima ngoku luluhlu olunye olwehlayo olucocekileyo.

PHAMBI KOKUBA UQALE
- Faka phezu kwenguqulelo yakho yangoku usebenzisa isifakeli sakho se-ZXP
  esiqhelekileyo, uze uqalise kwakhona i-After Effects kube kanye.
- Izicwangciso zakho, ithima, ii-preset nee-expression ozigcinileyo ziyagcinwa.

KUTSHA: IITHIMA ZE-ANIME EZINGAMA-33
- Izicwangciso ze-Flex > UMKHETHI WETHIMA > UMXHOLO WEPANELI ngoku zineqela elinye
  kwi-anime nganye:
  Attack on Titan (Levi), Berserk (Guts), Black Clover (Asta), Bleach (Ichigo,
  Hitsugaya), Chainsaw Man (Denji, Reze), Code Geass (Lelouch), Dandadan
  (Okarun), Death Note (Kira), Dragon Ball (Goku), Frieren, Fullmetal
  Alchemist (Edward), Hunter x Hunter (Killua, Kurapika, Hisoka), Jujutsu
  Kaisen (Gojo, Sukuna), KonoSuba (Megumin), Mob Psycho 100 (Mob), My Hero
  Academia (Bakugo, Deku, Todoroki), Naruto (Itachi, Minato), One Piece
  (Luffy, Zoro, Law), One-Punch Man (Saitama), Re:Zero (Rem), Solo Leveling
  (Jinwoo), Spy x Family (Anya) ne-Tokyo Ghoul (Kaneki).
- Umlinganiswa ngamnye unenkangeleko yakhe: oko kulandela imawusi yakho, uhlaselo xa
  ucofa iqhosha, oko kwenzekayo ngelixa ubambe iqhosha lasekhohlo, kunye noqhushumbo
  emva kokubamba malunga neesekhondi ezi-2.5.
- Zilula njengeethima ze-Demon Slayer: iziphumo zisebenza kuphela xa uhambisa imawusi
  okanye ucofa. Cima IZIPHUMO ZENDAWO ukuze ugcine imibala kuphela.

KUTSHINTSHILE: UMKHETHI WETHIMA
- Amakhadi e-Demon Slayer angaphantsi kwe-UMXHOLO WEPANELI asusiwe, ngoko ke
  Izicwangciso ze-Flex zimfutshane. Khetha yonke ithima kuluhlu olwehlayo
  lwe-UMXHOLO WEPANELI; luvuleka kwithima oyisebenzisayo.
- UKurama noBaryon ngoku bakwiqela le-Naruto.

KULUNGISIWE
- Iziphumo zemawusi zeethima (amanzi, amadangatye, umbane nezinye) zazidla
  ngokungabonakali ngaphakathi kwi-After Effects, nokuba Imodi Ephuculweyo icinyiwe.
  Amaxesha apho ipaneli ngokwayo ixakeke khona, kunye nokuqalisa okuxakekileyo,
  ayethathwa njengokucotha kwethima, ngoko iziphumo zazizicima. Ngoku, xa ikhadi lakho
  lemizobo lizizoba (iikhompyutha ezininzi), loo maxesha enza nje ukuba iziphumo zibe
  lula okwexeshana.

AKUTSHINTSHANGA
- Ilayisensi, ukwenza kusebenze kunye nawo onke amakhonkco asebenza kanye njengangaphambili.
- Iithima ezili-11 ze-Demon Slayer zijongeka kanye njengakwi-9.2.8.
- Zonke ezinye iithebhu nezixhobo zisebenza kanye njengakwi-9.2.8.
================================================================================

  yokuqinisekisa evulwa kwifestile.
- Xa i-LUNGELELANISA UNYAWO icinyiwe kwiZicwangciso ze-Flex, imiyalezo yokuqinisekisa
  yayingakwazi ukubonakala kwaphela. Ngoku ihlala ibonakala.

  emva kokuba ithima itshintshile. Ngoku luhlala lubonisa ithima evuliweyo.

AKUTSHINTSHANGA
- Ilayisensi, ukwenza kusebenze kunye nawo onke amakhonkco asebenza kanye njengangaphambili.
